text: A股三大股指午后回暖，上证综指跌幅一度缩窄至0.1%以内，现跌0.18%；深证成指跌幅缩窄至0.63%，创业板指现跌0.84%
text_en: A-shares' three major indexes rebound in the afternoon, with the Shanghai Composite's decline once narrowing to within 0.1%, now down 0.18%; the Shenzhen Component's decline narrows to 0.63%, and the ChiNext Index is now down 0.84%
